toegepas.voor: Net soos jy, het elke kind van die eerste boere by 'n gesin gehoort.
toegepas.na: Elke kind van die eerste boere het, net soos jy, by 'n gesin gehoort.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The fronted comparison with a comma before the inverted verb reads stiffly; placing it after the verb is the natural Afrikaans order and keeps the meaning.
toegepas.fout: A comma separates the fronted comparison from the inverted verb ('Net soos jy, het'), an English-style construction that reads stiffly in Afrikaans.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal gives natural Afrikaans word order with the same people, comparison and meaning, and touches no protected word.

vlae.rede: The heading asks the learner in the past tense whom they belonged to, while the block is about the first farmers' children; it may be meant as 'imagine you lived then', so it is flagged rather than changed (for example 'By wie hoort jy?' or a heading about the farmers' children).

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'kos verbou' is the natural Afrikaans collocation; 'kos kweek' is wooden.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'jou eie kos kweek' is natural Afrikaans, and 'verbou' can also mean 'rebuild', which may confuse a Grade 5 reader.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat ongelukkig was met hulle leier
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat met hulle leier ongelukkig was
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In a written relative clause the finite verb goes to the end.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Placing the prepositional phrase after the verb is normal Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Standard written Afrikaans uses 'ophou om te' with an infinitive here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'opgehou bestaan' is accepted standard Afrikaans; the proposal only adds words.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The sentence speaks of 'hulle lewe' in the past and then switches to 'jy' in the present; matching the person and tense follows the pattern of the parallel line in 'Kos en beeste'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The present-tense 'jy' label echoes the heading and opening and matches the parallel 'wie besluit' line, so the proposal is a lateral move that also loses the link to the learner.
